clause_ref: Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering Policy
text:
Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering Policy
Bharat Unity Bank Ltd.

heading_path: Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering Policy
text: 1. Purpose and Scope

heading_path: Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering Policy
1. Purpose and Scope
text: 1.1 This Policy sets out the Know Your Customer (KYC), Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Combating the Financing of Terrorism (CFT) standards of Bharat Unity Bank Ltd. (the Bank).

heading_path: Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering Policy
1. Purpose and Scope
text: 1.2 This Policy applies to all business units, branches and channels of the Bank, including digital and video-based onboarding.

heading_path: Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering Policy
text: 2. Definitions

heading_path: Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering Policy
2. Definitions
text: 2.1 Officially Valid Document (OVD) has the meaning assigned to it in the applicable directions of the Reserve Bank of India.

heading_path: Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering Policy
2. Definitions
text: 2.2 Principal Officer means the officer nominated by the Bank to furnish information to the Financial Intelligence Unit - India (FIU-IND).

heading_path: Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering Policy
text: 3. Governance

heading_path: Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering Policy
3. Governance
text: 3.1 Board approval and annual review of KYC Policy [KYC-C01]. This Policy shall be approved by the Board of Directors and reviewed at least annually, or earlier upon any material regulatory change. Control owner: Chief Compliance Officer. Frequency: Annual.

heading_path: Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering Policy
3. Governance
text: 3.2 Designated Director and Principal Officer [KYC-C02]. The Bank shall nominate a Designated Director and a Principal Officer and communicate their names, designation and contact details to FIU-IND, including upon any change. Control owner: Chief Compliance Officer. Frequency: Event Driven.

heading_path: Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering Policy
text: 4. Customer Acceptance

heading_path: Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering Policy
4. Customer Acceptance
text: 4.1 No anonymous or fictitious accounts [KYC-C03]. No account shall be opened in an anonymous or fictitious name. The Core Banking System shall block account activation unless the customer's OVD has been verified. Control owner: Head of Retail Operations. Frequency: Continuous.

heading_path: Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering Policy
4. Customer Acceptance
text: 4.2 V-CIP conduct standards [KYC-C04]. Video-based Customer Identification Process (V-CIP) sessions shall be conducted only by trained officials of the Bank, recorded end-to-end, geo-tagged and subjected to a liveness check before the account is activated. Control owner: Head of Digital Banking. Frequency: Event Driven.

heading_path: Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering Policy
text: 5. Customer Identification

heading_path: Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering Policy
5. Customer Identification
text: 5.1 Identity verification at onboarding [KYC-C05]. At onboarding, the identity and address of every individual customer shall be verified using an OVD or Aadhaar-based e-KYC authentication, and the outcome shall be recorded in the onboarding system. Control owner: Head of Retail Operations. Frequency: Event Driven.

heading_path: Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering Policy
5. Customer Identification
text: 5.2 Beneficial owner identification [KYC-C06]. For customers that are legal entities, the Bank shall identify the beneficial owner(s) as per the thresholds prescribed under the PML Rules and take reasonable measures to verify their identity. The Relationship Manager shall record a beneficial ownership attestation for each such customer. Control owner: Head of SME Banking. Frequency: Event Driven.

heading_path: Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering Policy
5. Customer Identification
text: 5.3 Sanctions screening before activation [KYC-C07]. Before any account is activated, the customer's name shall be screened against the UNSC sanctions lists and the lists of individuals and entities designated under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, 1967. Activation shall not proceed until screening is cleared. Control owner: Head of AML Operations. Frequency: Event Driven.

heading_path: Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering Policy
text: 6. Risk Categorisation and Ongoing Due Diligence

heading_path: Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering Policy
6. Risk Categorisation and Ongoing Due Diligence
text: 6.1 Customer risk categorisation [KYC-C08]. Every customer shall be assigned a risk category of Low, Medium or High at onboarding based on customer profile, geography, product and channel, and the category shall be reviewed upon any trigger event. Control owner: Chief Compliance Officer. Frequency: Event Driven.

heading_path: Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering Policy
6. Risk Categorisation and Ongoing Due Diligence
text: 6.2 Periodic KYC updation - High risk [KYC-C09]. Periodic updation of KYC shall be carried out at least once every two years for High risk customers. Control owner: Head of KYC Operations. Frequency: Biennial.

heading_path: Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering Policy
6. Risk Categorisation and Ongoing Due Diligence
text: 6.3 Periodic KYC updation - Medium risk [KYC-C10]. Periodic updation of KYC shall be carried out at least once every ten years for Medium risk customers. Control owner: Head of KYC Operations.

heading_path: Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering Policy
6. Risk Categorisation and Ongoing Due Diligence
text: 6.4 Periodic KYC updation - Low risk [KYC-C11]. Periodic updation of KYC shall be carried out at least once every ten years for Low risk customers. Control owner: Head of KYC Operations.

heading_path: Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering Policy
6. Risk Categorisation and Ongoing Due Diligence
text: 6.5 Alert review and STR filing [KYC-C12]. Transaction monitoring alerts shall be reviewed by AML Operations, and where a transaction is determined to be suspicious, a Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) shall be furnished to FIU-IND within seven working days of such determination. Control owner: Principal Officer. Frequency: Event Driven.

heading_path: Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering Policy
text: 7. Reporting and Record Keeping

heading_path: Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering Policy
7. Reporting and Record Keeping
text: 7.1 Cash Transaction Reports [KYC-C13]. Cash Transaction Reports (CTR) shall be furnished to FIU-IND for every month by the 15th day of the succeeding month. Control owner: Principal Officer. Frequency: Monthly.

heading_path: Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering Policy
7. Reporting and Record Keeping
text: 7.2 Record preservation - five years [KYC-C14]. Records of all transactions and of customer identification, including KYC documents and account files, shall be preserved for at least five years after the business relationship has ended or the account has been closed, whichever is later. Control owner: Head of Operations. Frequency: Continuous.
